title: feat: author computer commits as the caller's GitHub account
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Gen forwards the caller's linked GitHub account to user-scoped MCPs as `x-pollinations-user-github: id+username` (strips spoofed values; Composio strips it before forwarding)
- Computer MCP uses it as the default git identity: `username <id+username@users.noreply.github.com>`, so GitHub links commits to the profile
- `git config user.name/user.email` in a repo still overrides it; users without GitHub keep "Pollinations Agent"
- Tests: computer commit author + override; gen proxy forwards the header and ignores a spoofed one

Independent of #15026 (collective memory), but it gives those commits attribution too.

gist.headline: Commits know their gardener
gist.blurb: Computer MCP commits can now carry their gardener’s name. Link GitHub, let the agent tend a repo, and the resulting commits bloom on your profile.
gist.summary: Gen now passes a caller’s verified linked GitHub identity to user-scoped MCPs, allowing Computer MCP to author default git commits as `username <id+username@users.noreply.github.com>` while preserving repository-level git identity overrides.
gist.impact: Users with a linked GitHub account will see Computer MCP’s default commits attributed to their GitHub profile, while custom `git config user.name` and `user.email` settings still take precedence.
